dct_description_sm: Population Raster Niue 2020 Data Input: Household locations from Open Street Maps - HOSM Niue Building footprint. https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_niu_buildings Population allocated proportionally using 2011 census population counts at enumeration area level. Year Population Growth Rate of 0.76% has been applied to update population up to 2020 The human settlement footprint with census population allocated has been converted into a 100 m resolution raster. _Access this dataset from the [Pacific Data Hub](https://pacificdata.org/data/dataset/niu_population_grid_2020)_
